info.title: VBoards API
info.description: Per-user API for agents (Jarvis). Create a token in Settings > API tokens. The token acts as its owner (the auth user who created it): every read and write is scoped to the organizations where that user is a member; rows elsewhere return 404. Tokens carry scopes: `read` (GET endpoints), `write` (create/patch tasks and cards, add subtasks without queue, request a refine), `agent` (work that runs on the owner's computer: POST subtasks with queue=true, the Jarvis inbox, and the /api/agent-tasks routes of the local runner). Approving a plan (POST /schedule/{id}/approve) is not available to any token: it needs a signed-in session. A missing scope returns 403 {"error":"missing scope <name>"}. Tokens may expire (30/90/365 days or never).

bearer.description: vb_ followed by 43 base64url chars. Scopes (read, write, agent) are listed per operation

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired token (tokens created before user-linked tokens existed are invalid: recreate them)

E403.description: The token lacks the scope this endpoint needs: {"error":"missing scope read|write|agent"}

E404.description: Not found, outside the caller's organizations, or no team membership

E500.description: Server error. The body is always {"error":"internal error"}; details are only logged server-side
